description.value:
As part of the action to cast this power, you make a melee weapon attack against a target within your reach, and the power fails if you don't. On a hit, the attack deals its normal damage, and biting cold sinks into the target, giving it 1 slowed level until the start of your next turn. If the target fails to move at least 5 feet before then, it immediately takes 1d8 cold damage and the power ends.

At 5th level the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 cold damage, and the damage for failing to move rises to 2d8; both increase by a further 1d8 at 11th and 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
